title: Economic Evaluation Specification
primary_chapter_title: Lifecycle Cost, Pricing, and Benefit Realization
purpose: Define the economic decision, perspective, comparator, horizon, outcomes, costs, methods, uncertainty, safeguards, and validation.
notes: Synthetic example. Replace all values with authorized local evidence before institutional use.

records.Guidance: State the incremental decision and all realistic alternatives.
records.Institutional response: Compare AI-supported triage with current triage, staffing redesign, and a non-AI score.

records.Guidance: Define eligible volume, uptake, important heterogeneity, and access constraints.
records.Institutional response: Approximately 48,000 adult visits annually; analyze age, sex, language, socioeconomic vulnerability, and rurality.

records.Guidance: Distinguish hospital, payer, patient, societal, and environmental perspectives and identify who pays and benefits.
records.Institutional response: Hospital budget-impact perspective and health-system cost-effectiveness perspective; operating budget pays initially.

records.Guidance: Justify duration, timing of implementation, useful life, updating, residual value, and discount rates.
records.Institutional response: Three years with monthly budget cycles; apply the current national discounting policy.

records.Guidance: Separate final health outcomes, intermediate outcomes, process measures, workforce effects, quality, equity, trust, and environmental effects.
records.Institutional response: Safety, health outcomes, time to assessment, workload, experience, equity, trust, and environmental effects.

records.Guidance: Include acquisition, data, integration, infrastructure, training, review, governance, monitoring, incidents, updates, support, opportunity cost, and exit where incremental.
records.Institutional response: Licence, data, integration, validation, training, review, governance, security, monitoring, updates, incidents, and exit.

records.Guidance: Specify cost-consequence, cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, cost-benefit, budget impact, ROI, multi-criteria, or combined analysis.
records.Institutional response: Cost-consequence and budget impact for the pilot; net-benefit decision model for scale.

records.Guidance: Define deterministic, probabilistic, scenario, threshold, structural, subgroup, and value-of-information analyses.
records.Institutional response: Scenario, threshold, probabilistic, subgroup, structural, and value-of-information analyses.

records.Guidance: State willingness-to-pay or net-benefit rule, affordability threshold, mandatory safeguards, and conditions.
records.Institutional response: Positive expected net benefit and affordable cash flow, subject to mandatory safety, lawful-use, equity, oversight, and shutdown safeguards.

records.Guidance: Record model version, evidence date, technical verification, face validity, external review, reproducibility, and archive location.
records.Institutional response: Model v1.0; independent code review, trace testing, clinical face validity, and archived environment.
